items.html: In the death of ZA, the posterior of AVI descended to its upper third of Tifferet, but the posterior of Israel Saba veTvuna were not completed until the death of the Nukva of ZA. Hence, ZA takes the posterior of AVI, Malchut takes the posterior of Israel Saba veTvuna, and their lights clothe in them like the Mochin of ZA.
